item.title: Tsume Ato
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kappadou
  • 発売日: 2001-07-19
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 爪痕
  • 英語名: Tsume Ato

あらすじ

Main character lost his memory in a traffic accident. He now wakes up in a pavilion of a mysterious fantasy novelist active during Showa era. He is greeted by manager Misako who requests him to counsel two girls and recover memory this way. He spends more and more days here, but the memory does not return! One day a letter with threats arrives at the pavilion, followed by a phantom “golden mask” that causes mysterious disturbance. And at this point memories of his ugly past gradually start to return.

item.title: Maina ~Haja no Ketsumyaku~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kappadou
  • 発売日: 1999-10-29
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 舞菜 ～破邪の血脈～
  • 英語名: Maina Haja no Ketsumyaku

あらすじ

Yoichiro comes from an old religious family, but he’s unaware of his roots even though he has a potential. His parents worry about the decline of the clan and they decide to marry him on a talented spiritualist Mai even though he already has a fiance Yuko. The demon is aware of Yoichiro potential and he tempts Yoichiro through his classmate Taeko.
